description:
6,500+ curated AI apps from the HyperStore directory, searchable from any LLM via 8 MCP tools, 3 resources, and 3 prompts. Read-only, no auth.

## Tools (8)
- `search_apps`, `ai_search` — keyword + semantic search
- `get_app`, `list_apps`, `browse_apps` — directory browsing
- `list_categories`, `category_apps` — taxonomy navigation
- `get_homepage` — trending + featured

## Resources
- `hyperstore://app/{slug}` · `hyperstore://category/{slug}` · `hyperstore://catalog`

## Prompts
- `find_tool_for_task` · `compare_apps` · `discover_category`

**Install:** `uvx hyperstore-mcp`  ·  **Remote endpoint:** `https://mcp.store.hypergpt.ai/mcp`  ·  **License:** MIT
